interface.title: Vagalume: Treino (training mode of the Vagalume TESS variable-star reviewer)
interface.field: Astronomy: time-domain photometry, variable stars (TESS light curves, VSX submissions)
interface.stage_of_work: Human vetting and classification of pipeline candidates, practised here on cases with a known answer
interface.what_it_is_for: Trains a reviewer to judge TESS variable-star candidates. For each case it shows the phase-folded light curve, the per-pixel signal map, key numbers and an automatic checklist. The reviewer answers confirm, doubt or discard, then sees the correct answer, an explanation and where the clue was, and the app keeps calibration statistics, including the P-vs-2P period choice.

data.note: The demo opens straight into the Treino quiz using the bundled demo/treino_demo.db and its pre-rendered figures: 30 known-answer cases (TIC stars with LS or BLS periods). Case order is shuffled per session, so cases are identified here by TIC ID where the run recorded it, otherwise by their period and amplitude. Answers are kept in a history that persists while you move back and forth between cases. Nothing was uploaded or downloaded. This tree covers only the training mode; the README's main workflow (Revisão/fila review queue leading to a VSX record) was not reachable in the demo.

tree.general: Learn to decide whether a candidate periodic signal is real and belongs to the target, and track how well calibrated those decisions are
tree.specific: Practise the Vagalume confirm/doubt/discard decision on known-answer TESS cases in Treino mode and build up Treino accuracy (training only; the real review queue and VSX record were not reached)

features.name: Known-answer quiz card with reveal, clue and saved answers
features.general: Show the evidence for one item, collect a three-level judgement (accept / unsure / reject), then reveal the correct label, the reason, and which panel held the clue; moving back to an answered item shows its saved feedback
features.specific: Treino case: panels 1 and 2 plus checklist, then Confirmar / Dúvida / Descartar, then Você acertou/errou/Meio ponto, Resposta certa with catalogue source, and Onde estava a pista; ◀ Anterior / Próximo ▶ keep each case's answer
steps: inspect the folded-curve and pixel-map panels
press Confirmar, Dúvida or Descartar
read the colour-coded verdict and the 'Resposta certa' explanation
read 'Onde estava a pista'
press Próximo ▶, or ◀ Anterior to revisit an answered case
serves_tasks: Make the three-way decision and get the correct answer, explanation and clue
Recognise failure modes that should lead to a discard
Navigate between cases and revisit an answered case

features.name: Follow-up P vs 2P period question
features.general: For items whose true label is accepted and that have a reference value, ask a second question that picks between two candidate parameter values by comparing two renderings, then score it separately
features.specific: Segunda pergunta (shown when the correct answer is Confirmado and the VSX period ratio is 0.50 or 1.00, not ratio 1.00 with amplitude ≥10%): compare 'Dobrada em P' with 'Dobrada em 2P', optionally open 'Relembrar', press P or 2P, and see 'Período: você marcou X, o certo é Y' plus 'Acertos de período'
steps: answer the case
optionally open the 'Relembrar: o que muda entre P e 2P' explainer
compare the 2P fold with the P fold
press P or 2P
read the feedback and the period-accuracy counter
serves_tasks: Compare the curve folded at P with the curve folded at 2P to tell an eclipsing binary from a pulsator

features.name: Per-pixel signal localisation map
features.general: Heat map of signal strength across an image cutout, with markers for the target, the peak and nearby sources, to judge whether a signal comes from the intended source
features.specific: 'Amplitude do sinal por pixel' with a green + (target), red x (peak) and blue circles (neighbours); the title and the 'Pico do sinal' card give the offset in px, checked against the 1.0 px 'Sinal no alvo' limit
steps: find the red x
compare its position with the green + and the blue circles
read the px offset in the title, card and checklist
serves_tasks: Check that the signal comes from the target and not a neighbouring source

features.name: Automatic vetting checklist with suggestion
features.general: Rule-based pass/warn/fail list of quality criteria, with a suggested verdict that stays subordinate to human judgement
features.specific: Checklist rows (Sinal no alvo, Repete em outros setores, Ciclos no setor, Força do sinal, Vizinha brilhante (blend), Já no Gaia) marked ✅/⚠️/❌ beside metric cards, with a 'Sugestão do pipeline: Confirmar/Dúvida/Descartado' badge
steps: read the metric cards
scan the ✅/⚠️/❌ rows and their one-line reasons
compare the pipeline suggestion with your own reading of the curve
serves_tasks: Read the automatic checklist and summary metrics before deciding
Recognise failure modes that should lead to a discard

features.name: Calibration history with per-class bias
features.general: Running score that splits accuracy into overall, recent window and per true class, plus a mastery threshold, to expose systematic bias
features.specific: Header 'Acertos x de y' bar, Nível banner ('Treino em dia' = 80% over the last 20), and the 'Seu histórico' expander with Geral, Últimas N, Quando era Confirmado, Quando era Descartado and Período P ou 2P (Dúvida counts as half a point)
steps: answer cases
watch the header score bar
open 'Seu histórico'
compare the 'Quando era' columns for bias
check how many answers remain for 'Treino em dia'
serves_tasks: Review accuracy overall, recently, and split by true answer to reveal bias

features.name: Phase-folded light curve with binned median
features.general: Photometry folded on a trial period, drawn as points with a binned median line, so a real periodic signal shows as a thin shaped band and noise as a shapeless cloud; the same plot is reused at twice the period
features.specific: Panel 1 'Dobrada em P' (and 'Dobrada em 2P' in the second question): grey points with a black median line, amplitude read against the noise ('x o ruído'), with a Fullscreen button
steps: check whether the points form a thin band or a wide cloud
check whether the black median line has a repeating shape
compare the amplitude with the noise level
open fullscreen if needed and press Escape to return
compare with the 2P fold when it is shown
